title: Titanium PEM Bipolar Plate
alloyReason: Pt-coated Grade 1 CP-Ti (UNS R50250) is engineered for Titanium PEM Bipolar Plate in electrochemical applications where platinum cladding (2.5 µm minimum) provides catalytic surface activity while the ultra-ductile Grade 1 substrate (24% elongation) withstands thermal cycling without delamination. The Pt/Ti interface forms a diffusion bond at >50 MPa peel strength, ensuring long-term service in PEM electrolyzer bipolar plate (Grade 1, Pt-coated). This rationale is driven by pem electrolyzer bipolar plate (grade 1, pt-coated) and fat life requirements.
process: Closed-die forging net shape for hydrogen hardware geometry
CNC precision machining with SPC sampling
TIG welding all positions with SPC sampling
DPI dye penetrant inspect with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: Thermal oxidation 700C 2h in air to grow controlled 300nm TiO2 barrier layer for H2 permeation reduction — tailored for pem electrolyzer bipolar application
commonFailures: Irradiation embrittlement in flux >1e18 n/cm2 - mitigated by fine equiaxed alpha (ASTM 8+) microstructure — critical for pem electrolyzer bipolar performance

faq.q: What downhole temperature rating does Titanium PEM Bipolar Plate have?
faq.a: Grade 1 CP-Ti maintains >90% of room-temperature tensile and yield strength at 200°C and >80% at 300°C. Titanium PEM Bipolar Plate is suitable for pem electrolyzer bipolar in geothermal (HDR/EGS) wells up to 300°C with appropriate consideration of creep in threaded connections. Above 300°C, dedicated creep testing per ASTM E139 is recommended for design life validation.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium PEM Bipolar Plate orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium PEM Bipolar Plate is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium PEM Bipolar Plate?
faq.a: Each Titanium PEM Bipolar Plate shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for pem electrolyzer bipolar.
